# Ismael Marin — Software Engineer & Tech Lead

Ismael Marin builds backend systems, developer tools, and AI infrastructure. Ruby on Rails is his deepest production experience. He also works with Rust, Elixir/Phoenix, and Python. He is based in León, Mexico and is open to remote full-time, part-time, and contract opportunities.

## Experience

- Nebula Ideas, Head of Strategy / Technical Advisor (2010–present): Advises product teams on architecture, backend modernization, AI adoption, and product development while remaining hands-on with implementation.
- Dealerware, Software Engineer → Senior Software Engineer → Tech Lead (May 2022–April 2026): Worked on distributed systems processing approximately 10,000 telematics events per minute. Led a zero-downtime Elasticsearch-to-OpenSearch migration, authored 40+ ADRs/RFCs, and contributed 370+ merged pull requests across 20+ production repositories.
- Earlier roles include Lead Software Engineer at 3Pillar Global (Sep 2020–Oct 2021), United Virtualities (Aug 2019–Aug 2020), Tech Lead, B2B at Reservamos/reserhub (Aug 2018–Aug 2019), and Staff Engineering Manager / Lead Engineer at MagmaLabs (Feb 2016–Aug 2018).

Career and Dealerware figures come from the PDF résumé linked above.

## Selected open-source work

- rails-ai-bridge: Rails context files and read-only MCP introspection for AI coding assistants. https://github.com/igmarin/rails-ai-bridge — more than 10,000 total RubyGems downloads as of 2026-09-25 UTC: https://rubygems.org/gems/rails-ai-bridge
- ruby-skill-bench: Compares AI agent runs with and without added context in isolated Git workspaces, using blind judging. https://github.com/igmarin/ruby-skill-bench — more than 3,000 total RubyGems downloads as of 2026-09-25 UTC: https://rubygems.org/gems/ruby-skill-bench
- brigid: Rust CLI for guided codebase tutorials. https://github.com/igmarin/brigid
- rs-guard: I contribute to this Nebula Ideas Rust CLI for multi-provider AI code review in GitHub pull requests and local workflows. https://github.com/nebulaideas/rs-guard
- rust-core-skills: Rust agent skills covering ownership, type-driven design, error handling, project context, and Cargo testing. https://github.com/igmarin/rust-core-skills
- pi-vida: Launcher for language-specific coding-agent setups, combining skills, a safety gate, and ticket tracking across Pi and other supported hosts. https://github.com/igmarin/pi-vida
- elixir-phoenix-skills: Guidance for AI coding assistants working with Phoenix, LiveView, and Ecto. https://github.com/igmarin/elixir-phoenix-skills
